name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income support of ₹6000/year to farmer families in three installments of ₹2000 each
description_hi: किसान परिवारों को सालाना ₹6000 की सीधी आय सहायता — ₹2000 की तीन किस्तों में
offline_process: Visit nearest CSC/Common Service Centre with Aadhaar and land documents

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
description: Housing for all — interest subsidy on home loans up to ₹2.67 lakh
description_hi: सबके लिए आवास — होम लोन पर ₹2.67 लाख तक ब्याज सब्सिडी

benefits.benefit_summary: Up to ₹2.67 lakh interest subsidy on home loan

offline_process: Apply through bank/HFC while taking home loan

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
description: Health insurance cover up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care
description_hi: प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का स्वास्थ्य बीमा कवर
offline_process: Visit nearest Ayushman Bharat Kendra or hospital with Aadhaar

name: PM Street Vendor's Atmanirbhar Nidhi
description: Working capital loan up to ₹10,000 for street vendors with 7% interest subsidy
description_hi: स्ट्रीट वेंडर्स के लिए ₹10,000 तक का कार्यशील पूंजी ऋण
offline_process: Apply through Urban Local Body (ULB) or Common Service Centre

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Loans up to ₹10 lakh for non-corporate small business without collateral
description_hi: बिना गारंटी के छोटे व्यवसाय के लिए ₹10 लाख तक का ऋण

benefits.benefit_summary: Up to ₹10 lakh loan without collateral (Shishu/Kishor/Tarun)

offline_process: Visit any bank branch — SBI, PNB, BoB, or private banks

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
description: Free LPG connection to BPL households with first refill and stove
description_hi: BPL परिवारों को मुफ्त LPG कनेक्शन + स्टोव + पहली रिफिल

benefits.benefit_summary: Free LPG connection + stove + first refill

offline_process: Visit nearest LPG distributor with BPL card and Aadhaar

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
description: Accident insurance of ₹2 lakh for just ₹20/year premium
description_hi: सिर्फ ₹20/साल में ₹2 लाख का दुर्घटना बीमा
offline_process: Auto-debit from bank account — visit bank to enroll

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
description: Life insurance of ₹2 lakh for just ₹436/year premium
description_hi: सिर्फ ₹436/साल में ₹2 लाख का जीवन बीमा
offline_process: Auto-debit from bank account — visit bank to enroll

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan
description: Pension of ₹3000/month after 60 years for unorganized workers
description_hi: 60 साल के बाद ₹3000/महीना पेंशन — असंगठित कर्मचारियों के लिए
offline_process: Visit nearest CSC with Aadhaar and bank account

name: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana
description: Pension scheme for senior citizens — 8% guaranteed return
description_hi: वरिष्ठ नागरिकों के लिए पेंशन योजना — 8% गारंटीड रिटर्न
offline_process: Visit LIC office or apply online through LIC

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC
description: Full scholarship for SC/ST/OBC students pursuing higher education including tuition, maintenance, and books
description_hi: उच्च शिक्षा के लिए SC/ST/OBC छात्रों की पूरी फीस + रहने का खर्च + किताबें

benefits.benefit_summary: Full fee reimbursement + maintenance allowance + books

offline_process: Apply through National Scholarship Portal (NSP)

name: PM Vishwakarma Kaushal Samman
description: Skill development + tool kit + loan up to ₹3 lakh for traditional artisans
description_hi: पारंपरिक कारीगरों के लिए स्किल ट्रेनिंग + टूल किट + ₹3 लाख तक का ऋण
offline_process: Apply online or visit nearest CSC/MSME office

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Savings scheme for girl child — 8.2% interest, tax-free maturity
description_hi: बेटी के लिए बचत योजना — 8.2% ब्याज, टैक्स फ्री परिपक्वता
offline_process: Open account at Post Office or authorized banks

name: MUDRA Shishu Loan
description: Micro loan up to ₹50,000 for small business starters
description_hi: छोटे व्यवसाय शुरू करने के लिए ₹50,000 तक का माइक्रो ऋण
offline_process: Visit any bank with business idea

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Enterprises
description: Up to ₹10 lakh grant for food processing micro enterprises
description_hi: फूड प्रोसेसिंग माइक्रो उद्योगों के लिए ₹10 लाख तक का अनुदान

benefits.benefit_summary: Up to ₹10 lakh grant + credit linked subsidy

offline_process: Apply through State Nodal Agency or online portal

name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) Phase-II
description: ₹12,000 incentive for building Individual Household Latrine (IHHL)
description_hi: शौचालय बनाने के लिए ₹12,000 की प्रोत्साहन राशि
offline_process: Apply through Gram Panchayat or BDO office

name: Jal Jeevan Mission
description: Tap water connection to every rural household — 55 LPCD
description_hi: हर ग्रामीण घर में नल के पानी का कनेक्शन — 55 लीटर प्रति व्यक्ति प्रति दिन

benefits.benefit_summary: Free tap water connection at home

offline_process: Contact Village Water & Sanitation Committee (VWSC)

name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban) 2.0
description: Construction of community toilets and waste management in urban areas
description_hi: शहरी क्षेत्रों में सामुदायिक शौचालय और कचरा प्रबंधन
offline_process: Contact Urban Local Body (Municipality)

name: PMGDISHA — Digital Literacy
description: Free digital literacy training for 6 crore rural adults
description_hi: 6 करोड़ ग्रामीण वयस्कों के लिए मुफ्त डिजिटल साक्षरता प्रशिक्षण
offline_process: Register at nearest CSC/Common Service Centre

name: Skill India Mission (PMKVY)
description: Free skill training + certification + placement assistance for youth
description_hi: युवाओं के लिए मुफ्त स्किल ट्रेनिंग + सर्टिफिकेशन + प्लेसमेंट सहायता

benefits.benefit_summary: Free training + NSDC certificate + job placement

offline_process: Register at nearest Training Centre (TC)

name: Startup India Seed Fund
description: Seed funding up to ₹1 crore for DPIIT-recognized startups
description_hi: DPIIT-मान्यता प्राप्त स्टार्टअप्स के लिए ₹1 करोड़ तक का सीड फंड

benefits.benefit_summary: Up to ₹1 crore seed funding for startups

offline_process: Apply online through Startup India portal

name: ANMOL — Mother & Child Health
description: Cash incentives for pregnant women for institutional delivery and child immunization
description_hi: संस्थागत प्रसव और बच्चों के टीकाकरण के लिए गर्भवती महिलाओं को नकद प्रोत्साहन
offline_process: Register at nearest Anganwadi Centre or Health Sub-Centre

name: Poshan Abhiyaan
description: Nutrition support for children (0-6 years), pregnant women, and lactating mothers
description_hi: बच्चों (0-6 वर्ष), गर्भवती महिलाओं और स्तनपान कराने वाली माताओं के लिए पोषण सहायता

benefits.benefit_summary: Free nutritious food + supplements at Anganwadi

offline_process: Register at nearest Anganwadi Centre

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Free soil testing every 2 years + fertilizer recommendations for farmers
description_hi: किसानों के लिए हर 2 साल में मुफ्त मिट्टी जांच + उर्वरक सिफारिश

benefits.benefit_summary: Free soil health card + fertilizer recommendations

offline_process: Contact Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or Agriculture Department

name: Formation & Promotion of FPOs
description: ₹15 lakh equity grant + credit guarantee for Farmer Producer Organizations
description_hi: किसान उत्पादक संगठनों के लिए ₹15 लाख इक्विटी अनुदान + क्रेडिट गारंटी

benefits.benefit_summary: ₹15 lakh equity grant + credit guarantee for FPO

offline_process: Apply through SFAC or NABARD

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
description: 3% interest subvention + credit guarantee for agri infrastructure projects
description_hi: कृषि अवसंरचना परियोजनाओं के लिए 3% ब्याज सबवेंशन + क्रेडिट गारंटी

benefits.benefit_summary: Up to ₹2 crore loan at 3% interest subvention

offline_process: Apply through participating banks

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Short-term credit up to ₹3 lakh at 7% interest for farmers
description_hi: किसानों के लिए 7% ब्याज पर ₹3 लाख तक का अल्पकालिक ऋण
offline_process: Visit any bank branch with land records

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana — NRLM
description: Self-help group formation + bank linkage + livelihood support for rural poor women
description_hi: ग्रामीण गरीब महिलाओं के लिए स्वयं सहायता समूह + बैंक लिंकेज + आजीविका सहायता

benefits.benefit_summary: SHG formation + ₹1 lakh loan + skill training

offline_process: Contact Block Mission Management Unit (BMMU)

name: National Social Assistance Programme
description: Pension of ₹200-500/month for elderly, widows, and disabled persons
description_hi: बुजुर्गों, विधवाओं और विकलांग व्यक्तियों के लिए ₹200-500/महीना पेंशन
offline_process: Apply through Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office

name: MGNREGA — 100 Days Employment
description: Guaranteed 100 days of wage employment per rural household per year
description_hi: प्रति ग्रामीण परिवार प्रति वर्ष 100 दिन की गारंटीड मजदूरी रोजगार
offline_process: Apply at Gram Panchayat with Job Card application

name: National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM)
description: Skill training + self-employment + shelter for urban poor
description_hi: शहरी गरीबों के लिए स्किल ट्रेनिंग + स्वरोजगार + आश्रय

benefits.benefit_summary: Skill training + ₹2 lakh loan + shelter support

offline_process: Apply through Urban Local Body (ULB)

name: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
description: Direct cash transfer of subsidies to bank accounts linked with Aadhaar
description_hi: आधार से लिंक बैंक खातों में सब्सिडी की सीधी नकद हस्तांतरण

benefits.benefit_summary: Direct subsidy transfer to bank account

offline_process: Automatic — link Aadhaar to bank account

name: Udyam Registration for MSMEs
description: Free online registration for Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
description_hi: सूक्ष्म, लघु और मध्यम उद्यमों के लिए मुफ्त ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण

benefits.benefit_summary: Free MSME registration + eligibility for subsidies

offline_process: Fully online — no offline needed

name: Government e-Marketplace (GeM)
description: Online platform for MSMEs to sell directly to government departments
description_hi: MSMEs के लिए सरकारी विभागों को सीधे बेचने का ऑनलाइन प्लेटफॉर्म
offline_process: Register online with Udyam certificate

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao — Scholarship
description: Cash incentive for girl child education — ₹500 at birth, ₹1000 at Class 1, ₹2000 at Class 6
description_hi: बेटी की शिक्षा के लिए नकद प्रोत्साहन — जन्म पर ₹500, कक्षा 1 पर ₹1000, कक्षा 6 पर ₹2000

benefits.benefit_summary: ₹500 at birth + ₹1000 at Class 1 + ₹2000 at Class 6

offline_process: Register at Anganwadi Centre or District Child Protection Unit

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
description: ₹5,000 cash incentive for first live birth to pregnant women and lactating mothers
description_hi: पहले जीवित बच्चे के लिए गर्भवती महिलाओं और स्तनपान कराने वाली माताओं को ₹5,000 नकद प्रोत्साहन
offline_process: Register at Anganwadi Centre or Health Facility

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा पेंशन योजना
description: Pension of ₹300-500/month for widows aged 40-79 years from BPL families
description_hi: BPL परिवारों की 40-79 वर्ष की विधवाओं के लिए ₹300-500/महीना पेंशन
offline_process: Apply through Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension
description: Pension of ₹300-500/month for disabled persons aged 18-79 from BPL families
description_hi: BPL परिवारों के 18-79 वर्ष के विकलांग व्यक्तियों के लिए ₹300-500/महीना पेंशन
offline_process: Apply through Gram Panchayat or Social Welfare Department

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension
description: Pension of ₹200-500/month for senior citizens aged 60+ from BPL families
description_hi: BPL परिवारों के 60+ वर्ष के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों के लिए ₹200-500/महीना पेंशन
offline_process: Apply through Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed pension of ₹1000-5000/month after 60 years for unorganized sector workers
description_hi: असंगठित क्षेत्र के कर्मचारियों के लिए 60 साल के बाद ₹1000-5000/महीना गारंटीड पेंशन
offline_process: Visit bank branch or apply through bank account

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Bank loan between ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs
description_hi: SC/ST और महिला उद्यमियों के लिए ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ तक का बैंक ऋण

benefits.benefit_summary: ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore loan for SC/ST/women entrepreneurs

offline_process: Apply through scheduled commercial banks

name: Nikshay Poshan Yojana
description: ₹500/month nutritional support for TB patients during treatment
description_hi: TB मरीजों के इलाज के दौरान ₹500/महीना पोषण सहायता
offline_process: Register at DOTS Centre or Health Facility

name: National Programme for Prevention of Diabetes
description: Free screening, medicines, and glucometer for diabetes patients at government hospitals
description_hi: सरकारी अस्पतालों में मधुमेह रोगियों के लिए मुफ्त जांच, दवाइयां और ग्लूकोमीटर
offline_process: Register at nearest Government Health Facility

name: Health Minister's Cancer Patient Fund
description: Financial assistance up to ₹1 lakh for cancer treatment at government hospitals
description_hi: सरकारी अस्पतालों में कैंसर इलाज के लिए ₹1 लाख तक की आर्थिक सहायता

benefits.benefit_summary: Up to ₹1 lakh for cancer treatment

offline_process: Apply through treating hospital's Medical Social Worker

name: DigiLocker
description: Free digital document storage and sharing platform linked with Aadhaar
description_hi: आधार से लिंक मुफ्त डिजिटल दस्तावेज़ संग्रहण और साझा करने का प्लेटफॉर्म
offline_process: Register online with Aadhaar OTP

name: UMANG App
description: Single mobile app for accessing 300+ government services
description_hi: 300+ सरकारी सेवाओं तक पहुंचने के लिए एक मोबाइल ऐप

benefits.benefit_summary: Access 300+ government services in one app

offline_process: Download app from Play Store/App Store

name: Saubhagya — Household Electrification
description: Free electricity connection to all remaining un-electrified households
description_hi: बचे हुए सभी बिना बिजली के घरों को मुफ्त बिजली कनेक्शन
offline_process: Contact DISCOM office or apply through Gram Panchayat

name: UJALA — LED Bulb Distribution
description: LED bulbs at ₹10-20 (market price ₹300-500) for energy saving
description_hi: ऊर्जा बचत के लिए ₹10-20 में LED बल्ब (बाजार मूल्य ₹300-500)
offline_process: Visit designated distribution centre with ID proof

name: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
name_hi: पीएम सूर्य घर मुफ्त बिजली योजना
description: Free electricity up to 300 units/month through rooftop solar panels with 60% subsidy
description_hi: 60% सब्सिडी के साथ छत पर सोलर पैनल से 300 यूनिट/महीना तक मुफ्त बिजली

benefits.benefit_summary: 60% subsidy on rooftop solar + free electricity up to 300 units

offline_process: Register online and get installation through empanelled vendor

name: Khelo India — Fitness Scheme
description: Annual scholarship of ₹5 lakh for 1000 talented athletes + sports infrastructure
description_hi: 1000 प्रतिभाशाली एथलीट्स के लिए सालाना ₹5 लाख छात्रवृत्ति + खेल अवसंरचना
offline_process: Apply through State Sports Department or online portal

name: Craftsman Training Scheme (ITI)
description: Free vocational training in 137 trades at Industrial Training Institutes
description_hi: औद्योगिक प्रशिक्षण संस्थानों में 137 ट्रेडों में मुफ्त व्यावसायिक प्रशिक्षण

benefits.benefit_summary: Free ITI training + NCVT certificate + stipend ₹500-1000/month

offline_process: Apply through nearest ITI during admission period

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme
description: Apprenticeship training with stipend of ₹5000-15000/month in industries
description_hi: उद्योगों में ₹5000-15000/महीना स्टाइपेंड के साथ अप्रेंटिसशिप ट्रेनिंग
offline_process: Register on NAPS portal and apply to companies

name: Smart India Hackathon
description: National-level hackathon for college students with prizes up to ₹1 lakh
description_hi: कॉलेज छात्रों के लिए राष्ट्रीय स्तर का हैकथॉन — ₹1 लाख तक के पुरस्कार
offline_process: Register online through college nodal center
